raw: {"analysis":"Response LGQ incorrectly sequences the work by making all 24 service refactors depend on the shared config, when in reality only the billing and user-profile modules need query builder refactors. Response JNV correctly identifies the three parallel workstreams (shared config, billing refactor, user-profile refactor) and adds valuable cost-control measures around the flaky payment gateway check, such as escalating to manual triage after two failures rather than burning CI runs. Both responses properly address the Wednesday production freeze, dual-architect approval, and CI chargeback risk, but JNV's plan is more precise and practical for the tight deadline.","verdict":"JNV"}
